title: Physiological and biochemical responses of maize plants exposed to seed coating and foliar spray of distinct seaweed nanopowder
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2383-2394
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00521J, Paper
Rafiqi Mohammed Abdul Rahman, Mahendran Peyandi Paraman, Sharmila Rahale Christopher, Subramanian Kizhaeral Sevathapandian, Kannan Pandian, Gurusamy Arumugam, Kumutha Karunanandham
Seaweed nanopowder, especially Gracilaria edulis, boosts maize growth, nutrient uptake, and photosynthesis, offering a sustainable alternative to synthetic fertilizers.
